accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against #0B141A background

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds, use solid deep colors #0B141A or #202C33
Use 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a modern friendly vibe
Ensure 'Add to Cart' buttons are prominent and thumb-accessible on mobile
Use pill-shaped quantity controls (- 1 +) for ease of use
Images should have a subtle border radius (rounded-xl) and no harsh shadows, use 'ring-1 ring-white/10' instead
Toast notifications (Sonner) must be used for all 'Added to Cart' actions
Mobile View Cart button must float at the bottom with a glassmorphism effect
Do NOT use standard HTML select/input, use Shadcn Select/Input components
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the catalogue as a single-page app experience. Use 'react-router-dom' for navigation between Catalogue, Cart, and Checkout, but keep transitions smooth. The 'View Cart' button on mobile should be a sticky footer. Use Context API or Zustand for Cart state management. Ensure the dark theme is hardcoded as default (class='dark').
